descriptions.text: Ahoeitu, son of Ilaheva and Tangaloa Eitumatupua, climbs to the sky and is killed by his jealous brothers. His father directs the recovery of his remains and his return to life. He returns to earth as the first Tu‘i Tonga of divine descent, displacing an earlier worm-descended line.
